2698131.name: Chabad of Bennington County
2698131.note: Chabad.org's 'Chabad House of the Week' post (Facebook and Instagram, June 15 2026 by the post's ID, https://www.instagram.com/p/DZnNE7ek_i9/; read from the search index, as Facebook is not scraped): 'Chabad of Manchester has been led by Rabbi Menachem and Faygie Andrusier since the summer of 2015.' Its own About page, first published July 23 2015 (https://www.manchesterjewishlife.com/templates/articlecco_cdo/aid/3015631/jewish/About-Us.htm), agrees: they 'are living in Manchester, VT with their 8 children and are excited to make Manchester their home ... Please check our website for more information and launch dates'. Medium, because its chabad.org listing already went up on Nov 3 2014 (therebbesimpact.com also has 2014), before the move. Now at 171 Sargent Lane, Manchester.

118593.name: Chabad of College Hill
118593.note: No founding report found. Its nonprofit record dates from 2003; its listing number (118593) is from chabad.org's first directory (about 2003). Brown's Chabad House, 12 Olive St., for Brown, RISD and Johnson & Wales; Rabbi Mendel and Chana Laufer. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Chabad at Brown on Instagram (post of Aug 26 2025, dated by its post ID; https://www.instagram.com/p/DN1NbXF3oNQ/): 'we are back at 12 Olive Street! Open House tomorrow', after renovations (the Brown Daily Herald, Nov 2025, mentions the renovated Chabad of College Hill); it was at 12 Olive Street in lubavitch.com's directory in Sept 2011, and its chabad.org listing gives 14 Olive Street.
